records.name: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute
records.description: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute in Coimbatore is a leading ophthalmology specialty hospital offering clinical training and fellowship programs in various sub-specialties of eye care including cornea, retina, glaucoma, and paediatric ophthalmology. It operates a network of hospitals across Tamil Nadu and Kerala, providing students with exposure to high-volume tertiary eye care. The institute conducts outreach programs serving rural populations with preventable blindness.

records.name: Elite School of Optometry Chennai
records.description: Elite School of Optometry in Chennai, affiliated with SNDT Women's University and operated by Vision Research Foundation at Sankara Nethralaya, is one of India's premier optometry institutions offering B.Optom., M.Optom., and Ph.D. programs. Located within the Sankara Nethralaya complex, students have access to one of India's busiest and most respected eye hospitals for clinical training. The school has strong research programs in visual science, low vision rehabilitation, and contact lens practice.

records.name: Bharati Vidyapeeth (Optometry)
records.description: Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University in Pune offers B.Optom. and M.Optom. programs in optometry through its College of Optometry, one of the few recognized optometry programs in Maharashtra. The college has modern optometric instrumentation labs and clinical training facilities integrated with Bharati Hospital. Bharati Vidyapeeth's optometry program is known for producing competent vision care practitioners serving hospitals, optical retail chains, and community eye care programs.

records.name: DMLT Colleges (Various)
records.description: DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology) programs are offered by government and private medical institutions across all states, providing trained laboratory technicians for clinical, pathological, and biochemical testing. These programs are approved by respective state medical faculties or boards and typically run for two years including a practical internship. DMLT professionals are essential to the functioning of hospitals, diagnostic centers, and public health laboratories across India.

records.name: International College of Financial Planning
records.description: International College of Financial Planning (ICoFP) in New Delhi is a specialized institution for financial planning and wealth management education, the first institution in India to offer programs aligned with the Certified Financial Planner (CFP) designation. It offers MBA in Financial Planning, B.Com (Financial Planning), and PGPFM programs preparing students for careers in financial advisory, wealth management, and investment planning. ICoFP has strong industry linkages with leading banks, insurance companies, and wealth management firms for placements.

records.name: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports
records.description: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS) in Patiala is India's premier sports coaching and physical education institution. It offers diploma and master's programs in sports coaching across 30+ sports disciplines and functions as the umbrella organization of the National Institute of Sports. NSNIS trains coaches who serve at the national team, SAI training centers, and state sports academies, making it the cornerstone of India's coaching talent development ecosystem.

records.name: National Academy of Sports Management
records.description: National Academy of Sports Management (NASM) in Mumbai is a specialized institution offering postgraduate and professional programs in sports management, sports marketing, and event management. It provides practical training for sports administrators, managers, and marketers serving IPL franchises, sports federations, and sports marketing agencies. NASM has faculty from the corporate sports world and places graduates in positions with sports bodies, media companies, and fitness industry organizations.

records.name: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management
records.description: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management in Mumbai is a highly ranked private business school offering MBA (MMS), PGDM, and executive programs with strong specializations in finance, marketing, and business analytics. It is consistently ranked among the top 20 business schools in India and benefits from its Mumbai location for industry exposure and placements. K.J. Somaiya's alumni network spans BFSI, consulting, FMCG, and technology sectors across India.

records.name: National Sports University
records.description: National Sports University (NSU) in Imphal, Manipur is India's first national sports university, established in 2018 as an Institution of National Importance, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in sports sciences, sports coaching, sports technology, and sports management. It aims to create world-class sports professionals to power India's Olympic aspirations and has state-of-the-art sports infrastructure and residential facilities. NSU draws students from across India with a focus on producing evidence-based coaches, sports scientists, and administrators.

records.name: Swarnim Gujarat Sports University
records.description: Swarnim Gujarat Sports University (SGSU) in Gandhinagar is one of India's few dedicated sports universities, established by the Government of Gujarat, offering programs in sports sciences, sports coaching, sports management, and yoga. The university has excellent sports infrastructure and collaborates with Sports Authority of India and Gujarat's Olympic development program. SGSU graduates serve in Gujarat's school sports programs, state sports academies, and corporate wellness roles.
